course_name_original: Einführung in die allgemeine und anorganische Chemie Inorganic Chemistry
course_name_en: Introduction to General and Inorganic Chemistry

learning_outcomes.text: Students explore the periodic table and can make predictions about properties and behavior based on the element's position in the periodic table.
They are familiar with the molecular structure of matter.
They can apply chemical knowledge to real problems.
The basic principles of stoichiometry are known and can be applied to examples.
Students can write reaction equations; especially for acid-base reactions and redox processes.

syllabus_topics: Atomic structure and spectroscopic properties of the elements
bibliography: Mortimer, Charles E./Müller, Ulrich: Chemie. Das Basiswissen der Chemie, Georg Thieme Verlag: Stuttgart/New York (12. korr. und aktual. Auflage) 2015.
Riedel, Erwin/Meyer, Hans-Jürgen: Allgemeine und anorganische Chemie, de Gruyter: Berlin/Boston (12. Auflage) 2019.
